featured_reviews.name: Samir Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: JJ Jalebi at LBS Road Kurla makes Kurla a Complete Hub For Foodies.The food is good and made fresh.Overall good dining experience. Faced some difficulties related to parking, everything was good. The ambiance is nice and staff is very friendly. I would say it was kids friendly too. I found the menu to be affordable.Quantity was also very much!!

featured_reviews.name: Sabir Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited JJ restaurant and decided to try their Burmese soup based on the positive words of mouth from friends, it was a delightful experience and also try Nan Chicken it was also delicious. The restaurant atmosphere was Good!!
They have good variety in Tawa items. Will visit again to try different cuisine.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Bagade
featured_reviews.review_text:
J J Jalebi is an ultimate one stop shop for Meat Lover. Every dish was so yummy and delicious. Each dish was different by its looks as well as by taste. From my perspective best was Chicken in green Sauce and Chicken in Hot garlic - though rest all dishes were equally good.
Starters were well cooked - crispy from outside and soft from inside. Ambience was good, their hospitality and service was amazing, after definite interval use to visit and ask for additional order. We were so full with their starters only that we didn't had a chance to taste some of their signature sweet dishes
They also gave omlette and french fries on the house for our kids.
We appreciated the owner and the staff for providing such a wonderful experience.
We definitely visit this place again

Unfortunately, we had to make the tough decision to throw away the jalebi. I wanted to bring this to your attention, as we have always enjoyed your products in the past and hope this was just an isolated incident.

name: Bhawani - Sweet & Farsan
description:
Bhawani Sweets Mart is one of the oldest and most trusted sweet shops in Kurla, known for its rich tradition and authentic taste. Renowned especially for its crispy samosas and flavorful chutney, Bhawani Sweets Mart has become a favorite destination for food lovers.

But the delicacies don’t stop there — the shop also offers a wide range of traditional sweets, farsan, and Bengali specialties, each prepared with quality ingredients and a touch of homemade goodness.

Experience the timeless taste of tradition at Bhawani Sweets Mart — Kurla’s pride in every bite!

featured_reviews.name: Abigail Estibeiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been ordering from here through Swiggy and Zomato for the past few months, and I absolutely love their phirni. It's light, not overly sweet, and literally melts in your mouth. My entire family enjoys it.

Recently, I tried the Rasmalai Cake, and it was divine! I've had similar cakes from many other places, but the whipped cream is often too overpowering for my taste. Here, it's perfectly balanced and complements the flavors beautifully.

What touched me the most was the care they put into their packaging. It was raining heavily today, and they went the extra mile by adding an extra recyclable plastic layer over their usual paper packaging to ensure everything arrived safely. Their packaging is consistently excellent, and I really appreciate that they use recyclable materials,including the spoons.

I have a lot of respect for businesses that make an effort to be environmentally conscious while maintaining great quality and service. Rain or shine, they always deliver delicious desserts with thoughtful packaging. Thank you for the wonderful experience!
